name: Pheromone organ
description: The premise of the game in one part. Every creature in the hive carries this scent organ, lit — it is how they announce themselves and how they are recognized. The player carries the same organ in the same place, `dead`: cracked, unlit, silent. That is why they are hunted. Composed everywhere via `use`, so the whole roster shares one definition.

dead.description: The player's organ: no halo, no bloom, a hairline crack across a cold grey bulb. The silence that gets you chased.

faint.description: A dying signal — husks and spent stalks. Lit, but barely.

pulse.description: the scent broadcast — a slow swell
